description: Acme reference hook: at session start, put the connected Jentrix session's status into context. Read-only, exits 0 when the CLI is absent or no session is connected, no credential in argv. A customer plugin's hooks resolve `jentrix` through PATH (the absolute-path pin is applied only to the official plugin packages), hence the `command -v` guard; app-launched sessions without a shell PATH simply get no context line.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v jentrix >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; jentrix session status 2>/dev/null || true'
